div.div:
Notation
PK primary key (underlined) · FK foreign key (italic) · UQ UNIQUE
Crow's foot at the FK (child) table: zero-or-many, or zero-or-one when the FK is UNIQUE.
Double bar at the referenced (parent) table: exactly one when the FK is NOT NULL; circle+bar: zero-or-one when the FK is nullable.
No ON DELETE/ON UPDATE actions are declared (MySQL default: RESTRICT/NO ACTION). No engine is named in the DDL (MySQL 8 default: InnoDB); charset utf8mb4.
Source of truth: app/schema.sql. Cross-row rules (unit equality, stock ≥ 0, farmer-only assignment) are enforced in app/db.py, not by SQL.
